Q201.reason: Hypernatraemic dehydration is a water deficit, since water loss or intake shortfall raises serum sodium, whereas excess water intake causes hyponatraemia.

Q202.reason: Standing or sitting upright gives the fullest lung expansion and so more consistent, accurate peak flow readings, though the observation-of-technique reason in D is secondary.

Q203.reason: Extravasation specifically describes leakage of a vesicant (irritant) drug into surrounding tissue, causing damage, while infiltration refers to non-vesicant fluid.
